qualification: Descriptive diagnostic; no original gate is replaced
limits: No calibrated immutable lower bound or proof across all legal algorithms.
Instrumented time includes observer overhead; mode comparison is reported, not subtracted as an exact correction.
CPU wall difference is not mutex wait. Rosetta CPU coverage fails calibration and is not interpreted.
Retention in four-operation case includes all four exact pre-operation views; not a freehand product trace.
Complete sample includes synthetic setup, exhaustive validation, close and reclamation barrier, not canvas visible or saturated throughput.
Same-state Fresh diagnostic may retain unnecessary alternate; a legal alternate eviction policy is not benchmarked.
Twelve block intervals are descriptive per comparison, without family qualification.
